evidence.title: State of Wonder
evidence.text: The novel opens with Dr. Marina Singh reading a letter from Dr. Annick Swenson to Mr. Fox, Marina's boss and secret lover.

evidence.title: State of Wonder
evidence.text: Anders Eckman, her co-worker at the pharmaceutical company Vogel, has reportedly died at Dr. Swenson’s research site in the Amazonian rainforest.

evidence.title: State of Wonder
evidence.text: Dr. Eckman’s widow begs Marina to find out what happened, and Mr. Fox agrees to send her.

evidence.title: State of Wonder
evidence.text: Mr. Fox’s other motive is that Dr. Swenson has been given a blank check to conduct research into a new miracle drug, and refuses to inform him of her progress.

evidence.title: Khan Kluay
evidence.text: It is based on "Chao Praya Prab Hongsawadee" by Ariya Jintapanichkarn.

evidence.title: Khan Kluay
evidence.text: This movie is about Khan Kluay's two elephant children, another attack by the Hongsawadi (Burmese), and struggling whether to live with his wife or fight the Burmese.

evidence.title: Jumbo (film)

evidence.title: Jumbo (film)

evidence.title: Jumbo (film)
